Problem Statement:
Write a Java program that prints numbers from 1 to N using a do-while loop. 
Input Description:
The program should accept a single integer N as input. 
Output Description:
The program should print numbers from 1 to N, each on a new line. 
Sample Input:
5 
Sample Output:
1
2
